lead: A red `nvs-suite` check reports the *suite's* aggregate, so a one-case failure reads as the case the check names.
body: `[2 the deadlock]` came back `exit 1 -- 1897 passed, 1 failed` over `tests/conformance/`, which says nothing about which of the 1898 failed, while the named case passed 8 runs and the whole suite passed 3, one under a concurrent `cargo build --tests`. Re-run `target/debug/nvs.exe test tests/conformance/` and read the failing case's own name before believing the check's.
